title: Magnetic Field Line Visualization (3D Magnetic Dipoles)
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement a 3D visualization of magnetic field lines generated by magnetic dipoles, with support for interactively adjusting the number and positions of the dipoles.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import through ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Magnetic Dipole Field Physics Model]

The magnetic field B(r) produced by a magnetic dipole at point c is:
  B(r) = (μ₀ / 4π) × [3(m·r̂)r̂ - m] / |r - c|³

Where:
  μ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ T·m/A (vacuum permeability)
  m = (mx, my, mz) is the magnetic moment vector
  r̂ = (r - c) / |r - c| is the unit direction vector
  Simplification: μ₀/4π = 1 × 10⁻⁷ (for visualization convenience, a simplified constant may be used, such as μ₀/4π = 1.0)

Total field B_total(r) = Σ B_dipole_i(r), summed over all active dipoles

Initial 2 dipoles:
  - Dipole 1: position (0, 0, -1.5), magnetic moment m = (0, 1, 0) (pointing toward +y, vertically upward)
  - Dipole 2: position (0, 0, 1.5), magnetic moment m = (0, 1, 0) (pointing toward +y, vertically upward)

[Magnetic Field Line Tracing (RK4 Integration)]

Starting from seed points, trace the magnetic field lines by integrating along the magnetic field direction using the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method:

Seed point generation:
  Uniformly distribute seed points on a sphere around each dipole position
  seedDensity seed points per dipole (default 20, adjustable from 10-50)
  Seed points are 0.3 units from the dipole center

RK4 integration steps:
  Given the current position p and step size ds = 0.05:
  k1 = normalize(B(p)) × ds
  k2 = normalize(B(p + k1/2)) × ds
  k3 = normalize(B(p + k2/2)) × ds
  k4 = normalize(B(p + k3)) × ds
  p_next = p + (k1 + 2k2 + 2k3 + k4) / 6

Termination conditions:
  - Number of integration steps > 500
  - |B| < 1e-6 (field is too weak)
  - Distance from any dipole center < 0.1 (enters a singularity)
  - Distance from the origin > 10 (outside the visible range)

Bidirectional forward and backward integration: From each seed point, integrate one line along the +B direction and another along the -B direction, then join them into a complete magnetic field line

[Magnetic Field Line Rendering]
(1) Render each magnetic field line using THREE.Line or THREE.TubeGeometry(radius=0.02)
(2) Map the color according to field strength |B| using a color lookup table (from blue [weak] → green → yellow → red [strong])
(3) Represent each dipole using a small sphere + arrow (sphere = dipole position, arrow = magnetic moment direction)
   - Use ArrowHelper or a custom arrow, with length 0.5 and color white

[Interaction]
(4) Dipoles must be draggable (implement simple raycaster + drag logic, dragging on the xz plane)
    Recalculate all magnetic field lines after dragging a dipole
(5) Add dipole button (id="addDipole"): Add a new dipole at a random position (maximum 4 dipoles)
(6) Remove dipole button (id="removeDipole"): Remove the most recently added dipole (minimum 1 dipole)
(7) Magnetic field strength multiplier slider (id="fieldStrength"): range 0.1-5.0, step 0.1, default 1.0
    Multiply the magnitude of every dipole's magnetic moment by this value
(8) Seed point density slider (id="seedDensity"): range 10-50, step 5, default 20
    Regenerate the seed points and magnetic field lines when it changes

[Additional Rendering Requirements]
(9) Background color: #0a0a1a
(10) Add AxesHelper(5) to display the coordinate axes
(11) OrbitControls
(12) Semi-transparent reference plane at y=0

[HUD]
(13) Number of dipoles (id="dipoleCount")
(14) Number of magnetic field lines (id="streamlineCount")
(15) Current magnetic field strength multiplier (id="strengthDisplay")

[State Exposure (Required)]
Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame:
  - dipoleCount: number of dipoles
  - dipoles: [{x,y,z, mx,my,mz}, ...] position and magnetic moment of each dipole
  - streamlineCount: total number of magnetic field lines
  - seedDensity: seed point density
  - fieldStrength: magnetic field strength multiplier

Output a single standalone HTML file.
physics_constraints: RK4 integration for streamline tracing with step size ds=0.05
Bidirectional tracing: +B and -B from each seed point
Superposition: total field = sum of all dipole contributions
Streamline termination: |B|<1e-6, distance<0.1 from dipole, distance>10 from origin, or >500 steps
Seed points uniformly distributed on sphere of radius 0.3 around each dipole
Field strength scaling must linearly affect magnetic moment magnitudes
No NaN in streamline positions (singularity avoidance near dipole centers)
Adding/removing dipoles must properly update all streamlines
